$comment: Authored guide for the GenAI / RAG track (s22). The retrieval, prompt-assembly and eval examples are pure Python (a toy lexical index), so they really execute and their stdout is captured by scripts/guides.cjs. The LLM call itself is described in steps, never faked as a local run.

guides.title: RAG: Chunk, Retrieve, Ground & Evaluate
guides.what: RAG = retrieval + generation: apne documents ko chunks me todo, unhe index karo, query par relevant chunks laao, aur model ko sirf usi context se jawab likhne do — citation ke saath.
guides.why: LLM apne parameters se jawab 'bana' deta hai (hallucination) aur private/fresh data nahi jaanta. RAG grounding deta hai: jawab source se bandha hota hai, aur update sirf index refresh se hota hai (retraining nahi).
guides.whereUsed: Docs/support assistants, policy aur order lookups, codebase Q&A, aur internal knowledge search.
prereqs: FastAPI Request, Validation & Response (serving ke liye)
guides.howItWorks: Offline: chunk (size + overlap) → embedding → vector index. Online: query embed → top-k similarity search → context assembly (chunk ids ke saath) → LLM call under a prompt contract → answer + citations. Do jagah evaluation hoti hai: retrieval (hit-rate/recall@k) aur generation (faithfulness/correctness).
guides.syntax:
# offline
chunks = chunk(doc, size=800, overlap=100)
index = [(c.id, embed(c.text)) for c in chunks]

# online
hits = top_k(index, embed(question), k=5, threshold=0.35)
if not hits:
    return "context me nahi hai"        # abstain
prompt = build_prompt(question, hits)   # ids included
answer = llm(prompt)

examples.code:
docs = {
    "d1": "python list methods append extend remove",
    "d2": "sets give o(1) membership and dedupe",
    "d3": "offline retrieval uses cosine similarity",
}

def retrieve(query, k=2):
    qs = set(query.lower().split())
    scored = [(d, len(qs & set(text.split()))) for d, text in docs.items()]
    return sorted((s for s in scored if s[1] > 0), key=lambda p: -p[1])[:k]

print(retrieve("set membership dedupe"))
print(retrieve("kubernetes cluster"))
explain: Token overlap ek explainable baseline hai — production me embedding search isse behtar hoti hai par ye zero-dependency version debugging me kaam aata hai.
Sirf positive score wale chunks lautate hain, isliye zero-hit par khaali list milti hai (ye abstain ka signal hai).
Threshold ke bina har query kuch na kuch lauta degi — aur wahi hallucination ka pehla karan hai.

examples.code:
chunks = [
    {"id": "d2", "text": "sets give o(1) membership and dedupe", "score": 2.0},
    {"id": "d4", "text": "offline retrieval uses cosine similarity", "score": 0.5},
]

def build_prompt(question, chunks, threshold=1.0):
    kept = [c for c in chunks if c["score"] >= threshold]
    if not kept:
        return "NO_CONTEXT: jawab context me nahi hai"
    ctx = "\n".join(f"[{c['id']}] {c['text']}" for c in kept)
    return f"Answer only from the context and cite ids.\n\nContext:\n{ctx}\n\nQ: {question}"

print(build_prompt("dedupe kaise?", chunks))
print(build_prompt("kubernetes?", []))
explain: Score threshold se kam-relevance chunk prompt me jata hi nahi — isse grounding better hoti hai aur tokens bhi bachte hain.
Har context block ke saath stable id bhejna citations ko reliable banata hai (warna model id andaaza lagata hai).
Zero-hit case ka explicit jawab ('NO_CONTEXT') model ko apni memory se banane se rokta hai.
Retrieval evaluation generation se alag hai: recall@k yahi batata hai ki sahi chunk aaya ya nahi.
recall@1 vs recall@2 ka farq se pata chalta hai ki top-1 ranking weak hai ya retrieval hi.
Frozen eval set (small, versioned) hi honest improvement ka proof hai — 'better lagta hai' nahi.

howToCode.detail: Chunk size aur overlap data ke shape se chuno (table-heavy PDF me structure-aware). Bahut chhota chunk context todta hai, bahut bada noise laata hai.
Top-k plus score threshold — threshold ke bina har query kuch lauta deti hai aur model galat context par jawab bana deta hai.
howToCode.code:
hits = top_k(index, q, k=5, threshold=0.35)
if not hits: return abstain()

howToCode.detail: Context ke saath chunk ids bhejo, model se structured output (answer + source_ids) maango, aur 'sirf context se jawab do, warna abstain' rule likho.
Retrieval par recall@k/hit-rate aur generation par faithfulness/correctness — ek hi 'accuracy' me mila dena debug impossible banata hai.

commonMistakes: Zero-hit par bhi top-k bhej dena (ya context khaali chhod dena) — model apni memory se jawab likh deta hai.
Citation ids prompt me na bhejna, phir citation ka reliable hone ki umeed rakhna.
Chunk size ko tune na karna (sabse zyada impact wala knob yahi hai).
Grounding ko sirf prompt instruction se maangna — output schema validation ke bina.
Retrieval aur generation ko ek metric me mila dena.
bestPractices: Citations ko output schema ka part banao (structured output + validation).
Relevance threshold par explicitly abstain karo — 'context me nahi hai' ek valid answer hai.
Prompt me context dedupe karo aur max tokens cap lagao (cost + noise dono kam).
Eval set frozen rakho (JSONL + version) aur regression gate lagao.
Chunk ids ko stable rakho taaki citation aur trace id match karein.
guides.realWorld: Support assistant jo article ids cite karta hai, policy lookup jahan 'docs me nahi mila' acceptable answer hai, aur internal codebase Q&A — teeno me yahi pipeline chalti hai. Interview me 'recall@5 0.62 se 0.86 (table-aware chunking + hybrid retrieval)' bolna strong evidence hai.

practice.text: Ek chunk(text, size, overlap) function likho aur overlap ka effect word count par dikhaao.
Retrieval ke liye hit-rate aur recall@k implement karo aur ek score threshold tune karo.
Ek full eval harness likho: 20 cases, recall@k + abstention rate + markdown report — CI me gate karne layak.

interview.q: RAG aur fine-tuning me kab kaunsa?
interview.a: RAG tab jab knowledge badalti rahe aur citations chahiye (update = index refresh). Fine-tuning tab jab style/format/behaviour chahiye ya latency critical ho. Dono saath bhi use hote hain.
Retrieval threshold + abstention, chunk ids ke saath grounded prompt, structured output validation, aur citation-checking eval — sirf prompt me 'sach bolo' likhna kaafi nahi.

interview.q: RAG me evaluation do level par kyun?
interview.a: Retrieval fail ho to model ke paas sahi context hi nahi tha; generation fail ho to context tha par jawab galat bana. Dono ko alag measure karke hi pata chalta hai fix kahan karna hai.

guides.miniChallenge: Ek toy RAG evaluator likho jo 5 documents par query de, top-k laute, abstain kare jab score threshold se neeche ho, aur recall@k print kare.
guides.debugTask: Citations galat chunk ka naam de rahe hain jabki answer sahi hai. Prompt me kya missing hoga, aur fix kya hai?
revision: chunk → embed → index → retrieve → ground → cite
Chunk ids prompt me, output schema me citations
Zero-hit par abstain ek valid answer hai
guides.interviewTip: Interview me RAG ko do-stage system ki tarah describe karo aur har stage ka metric batao — isse pata chalta hai ki tum measurement culture laate ho, sirf prompt engineering nahi.
